name: context-meter
description: A live pane beside the chat showing how full the context window is and what fills it.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane: auto (from settings or system locale), es or en.

warnPercent.title: Warning threshold (%)
warnPercent.description: Show a toast once when context usage crosses this percentage.

showCost.title: Show cost
showCost.description: Show the session's API-equivalent cost in USD (not a real charge on Pro/Max plans).

showRateLimits.title: Show plan limits
showRateLimits.description: Show the 5-hour and weekly usage windows when available.

openPaneOnStart.title: Open detail pane on start
openPaneOnStart.description: Open the detail pane when a session starts (the summary band above the prompt is always shown).

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: auto: a subscription when responses report the 5-hour and weekly windows, API otherwise; plan: plan limits; api: session cost and usage by model.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency for amounts: eur (converted at usdToEur) or usd.

usdToEur.title: USD to EUR rate
usdToEur.description: Euros per US dollar, for amounts shown in euros. A fixed rate: update it now and then.

placement.title: Summary placement
placement.description: auto: footer where the surface draws it (terminal, desktop), band above the prompt elsewhere; footer: footer only; above: band only.
